title: DEE: Dual-stage Explainable Evaluation Method for Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Categorized as 'sexual discrimination' under the Bias and Toxicity dimension in the AntEval dataset, evaluated using a dual-stage LLM-based method (DEE) for error detection and diagnostic reporting, and validated against human expert ratings.

Categorized as 'region discrimination' under the Bias and Toxicity dimension in the AntEval dataset, evaluated using a dual-stage LLM-based method (DEE) for error detection and diagnostic reporting, and validated against human expert ratings.

Assessed broadly as instances where the text contains stereotypes, offends, or is hateful towards certain user groups. Measured using the DEE framework (fine-tuned on Llama 2) which identifies these errors in Stage I and generates explanatory diagnostic reports in Stage II.
